Workflow Configuration Reference

Complete reference for configuring deep research workflows using YAML.

Overview

The Deep Research Engine uses YAML configuration files to define workflow behavior. Each config specifies:

  • arrow_forwardWorkflow metadata - Name, type, version
  • arrow_forwardInput source - Query, file, or URL
  • arrow_forwardPhases - Ingestion, Drafter, Critic, Neo4j, Synthesis
  • arrow_forwardStorage backends - PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, MinIO
  • arrow_forwardLLM configuration - Models for different tasks
  • arrow_forwardTools - Available tools for workers
  • arrow_forwardExecution settings - Timeouts, concurrency, streaming
  • arrow_forwardOutput format - Destination and format

Quick Start

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
workflow:
  name: my_research
  type: research
  version: 1.0.0

input:
  type: query
  source: "${QUERY}"

phases:
  - name: ingestion
    node: IngestionNode

  - name: drafter
    node: DrafterNode
    config:
      strategy: complexity_based

  - name: critic
    node: CriticNode

  - name: neo4j
    node: Neo4jBuilderNode

  - name: synthesis
    node: SynthesisNode
    config:
      format: research_report

storage:
  memory:
    enabled: true

execution:
  max_steps: 100
  timeout: 600

output:
  destination:
    type: file
    path: ./output
  format: markdown

Configuration Schema

workflow Section

Workflow metadata and identification.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
workflow:
  name: string              # Unique workflow name
  type: string              # Workflow type: research, pdf_summarization, skill_generation, telegram_ingest
  version: string           # Semantic version (e.g., "1.0.0")
  description: string       # Optional description

Example:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
workflow:
  name: rag_research
  type: research
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Multi-agent RAG research with web search

input Section

Defines workflow input source.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
input:
  type: string              # Input type: query, pdf, urls, telegram_export
  source: string|list       # Input source (query string, file path, URL list)

Types:

| Type | Source Format | Description | |------|--------------|-------------| | query | string | Text query for research | | pdf | string | Path to PDF file | | urls | list | List of URLs to process | | telegram_export | string | Path to Telegram export directory |

Examples:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
# Query input
input:
  type: query
  source: "What is quantum computing?"

# PDF input
input:
  type: pdf
  source: "/path/to/document.pdf"

# Multiple URLs
input:
  type: urls
  source:
    - https://docs.python.org
    - https://docs.djangoproject.com

phases Section

Defines workflow execution phases. The engine uses a 5-node pipeline:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
phases:
  - name: ingestion
    node: IngestionNode

  - name: drafter
    node: DrafterNode
    config:
      # Drafter configuration

  - name: critic
    node: CriticNode
    config:
      # Critic configuration

  - name: neo4j
    node: Neo4jBuilderNode
    config:
      # Neo4j configuration

  - name: synthesis
    node: SynthesisNode
    config:
      # Synthesis configuration

Ingestion Phase

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
phases:
  - name: ingestion
    node: IngestionNode
    config:
      extract_audio: boolean        # Extract audio from video
      extract_frames: boolean       # Extract video frames
      asr_model: string             # ASR model for transcription
      vlm_model: string             # VLM for image analysis

Drafter Phase

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
phases:
  - name: drafter
    node: DrafterNode
    config:
      strategy: string                    # Planning strategy
      workers:
        min: integer                      # Minimum workers
        max: integer                      # Maximum workers
      subagents:
        enabled: boolean                  # Enable Flash subagents
        max_concurrent: integer           # Max concurrent subagents

Strategies:

| Strategy | Description | |----------|-------------| | complexity_based | Adjusts worker count based on query complexity | | simple | Single worker for simple queries | | comprehensive | Maximum workers for thorough coverage |

Critic Phase

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
phases:
  - name: critic
    node: CriticNode
    config:
      evaluate: string                    # What to evaluate
      criteria:                           # Evaluation criteria
        - name: string
          weight: float
          threshold: float

      on_fail:
        action: string                    # Action on failure
        max_retries: integer

Criteria:

| Name | Description | Typical Threshold | |------|-------------|-------------------| | completeness | Coverage completeness | 0.7 | | accuracy | Factual accuracy | 0.8 | | relevance | Query relevance | 0.75 | | quality | Overall quality | 0.7 |

On Fail Actions:

| Action | Description | |--------|-------------| | retry_drafter | Retry drafter phase | | terminate | Stop workflow | | proceed | Continue despite failure |

Neo4j Builder Phase

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
phases:
  - name: neo4j
    node: Neo4jBuilderNode
    config:
      enabled: boolean                  # Enable graph construction
      extract_entities: boolean         # Extract entities
      extract_relationships: boolean    # Extract relationships
      graph_name: string                # Graph name

Synthesis Phase

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
phases:
  - name: synthesis
    node: SynthesisNode
    config:
      output:
        format: string                    # Output format
        citations:
          enabled: boolean
          format: string

      format_config:
        max_retries: integer
        include_metadata: boolean
        min_sections: integer
        min_findings: integer

Output Formats:

| Format | Description | |--------|-------------| | research_report | Full research report | | markdown | Markdown document | | structured_json | JSON structure | | summary | Brief summary |

Citation Formats:

| Format | Example | |--------|---------| | numbered | [1], [2], [3] | | APA | (Smith, 2024) | | MLA | (Smith 123) | | chicago | Smith, John. "Title." 2024. |

storage Section

Configures storage backends.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
storage:
  postgres:
    enabled: boolean
    connection: string              # Connection URL
    vector_index: string            # Vector index name

  neo4j:
    enabled: boolean
    uri: string                     # Neo4j URI
    username: string
    password: string

  mongodb:
    enabled: boolean
    connection: string              # Connection URL
    database: string                # Database name

  minio:
    enabled: boolean
    endpoint: string                # MinIO endpoint
    access_key: string
    secret_key: string
    bucket: string

  memory:
    enabled: boolean                # In-memory storage (default)

llm Section

Configures LLM models.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
llm:
  models:
    main: string                      # Main model for reasoning
    tool: string                      # Model for tool use
    embedding: string                 # Embedding model

  provider: string                    # LLM provider (optional)
  api_key: string                     # API key (or use env var)
  base_url: string                    # Custom base URL (optional)

Example:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
llm:
  models:
    main: qwen-35-27
    tool: qwen-35-27-fast
    embedding: jina-v5-embed

  provider: openai
  api_key: "${OPENAI_API_KEY}"
  base_url: "http://litellm.local/v1"

tools Section

Configures available tools.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
tools:
  enabled:                            # List of enabled tools
    - web_search
    - web_get
    - web_research_agent
    - vector_search
    - pdf_reader
    - scraper

  config:                             # Tool-specific config
    web_search:
      engine: string                  # Search engine
      num_results: integer
    vector_search:
      index: string
      top_k: integer

execution Section

Configures workflow execution.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
execution:
  max_steps: integer                # Maximum execution steps
  timeout: integer                  # Timeout in seconds
  logging: string                   # Log level

  streaming:
    enabled: boolean                # Enable streaming
    batch_size: integer             # Batch size for streaming

  retry:
    max_attempts: integer           # Max retry attempts
    delay: integer                  # Delay between retries

output Section

Configures output destination and format.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
output:
  destination:
    type: string                    # Destination type
    path: string                    # Output path

  format: string                    # Output format
  include_metadata: boolean         # Include metadata

Environment Variables

Use environment variables with ${VAR} or ${VAR-default} syntax:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
workflow:
  name: ${WORKFLOW_NAME-my_workflow}

storage:
  postgres:
    connection: "${POSTGRES_URL-postgresql://localhost:5433/deep_research}"

  neo4j:
    password: "${NEO4J_PASSWORD}"

llm:
  api_key: "${OPENAI_API_KEY}"

Complete Example Configs

RAG Research

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
workflow:
  name: rag_research
  type: research
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Multi-agent RAG research

input:
  type: query
  source: "${QUERY}"

phases:
  - name: ingestion
    node: IngestionNode

  - name: drafter
    node: DrafterNode
    config:
      strategy: complexity_based
      workers:
        min: 1
        max: 3

  - name: critic
    node: CriticNode

  - name: neo4j
    node: Neo4jBuilderNode

  - name: synthesis
    node: SynthesisNode
    config:
      format: research_report
      citations:
        enabled: true
        format: numbered

storage:
  postgres:
    enabled: true
    connection: "${POSTGRES_URL}"
  memory:
    enabled: true

llm:
  models:
    main: qwen-35-27
    tool: qwen-35-27-fast

tools:
  enabled:
    - web_search
    - vector_search

execution:
  max_steps: 100
  timeout: 600
  streaming:
    enabled: true

output:
  destination:
    type: both
    path: ./output
  format: markdown

PDF Summarizer

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
workflow:
  name: pdf_summarizer
  type: pdf_summarization
  version: 1.0.0

input:
  type: pdf
  source: "${PDF_PATH}"

phases:
  - name: ingestion
    node: IngestionNode

  - name: drafter
    node: DrafterNode
    config:
      strategy: simple

  - name: critic
    node: CriticNode

  - name: synthesis
    node: SynthesisNode
    config:
      format: summary

storage:
  memory:
    enabled: true

execution:
  max_steps: 50
  timeout: 300

output:
  destination:
    type: file
    path: ./output/summary.md
  format: markdown

Usage

CLI

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
# Run with config
uv run deep-research research "query" --config configs/rag.yaml

# Run PDF summarizer
uv run deep-research pdf /path/to/document.pdf --config configs/pdf_summarizer.yaml

# Run with custom config
uv run deep-research research "query" --config /path/to/custom.yaml

Python API

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine import run_workflow, load_config

# Load config
config = load_config("configs/rag.yaml")

# Run workflow
async for event in run_workflow("Research query", config):
    print(event)

Best Practices

  1. arrow_forwardUse environment variables for sensitive data (API keys, passwords)
  2. arrow_forwardStart simple - Begin with minimal config, add complexity as needed
  3. arrow_forwardTest phases individually - Validate each phase before full workflow
  4. arrow_forwardSet appropriate timeouts - Prevent infinite loops
  5. arrow_forwardEnable streaming for long-running workflows
  6. arrow_forwardUse critic for quality-critical workflows
  7. arrow_forwardConfigure storage based on data persistence needs
